content.title: <RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">WELCOME TO BAWBAGS OF ARK</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.White>A community-driven PvE cluster built for balanced progression, long-term adventures and a good laugh. Build, breed, explore or take on the bosses - all at your own pace.</>

<TextStyle.White>Earn </><TextStyle.Green>15 tokens every 15 minutes</><TextStyle.White> automatically while playing, and spend them in our webshop.</>

<TextStyle.White>Link your account to our website for a </><TextStyle.Green>one-off 50-token bonus.</>

<TextStyle.White>Make yourself at home, and join us on Discord!</>
